operations.message: Start: push_rear(50) — single element, FRONT and REAR both at index 3
push_rear(60) → REAR grows right to index 4
push_front(40) → FRONT grows left to index 2. Watch blue pointer!
push_rear(70) → REAR grows right again to index 5
push_front(30) → FRONT grows left to index 1. Deque: [30,40,50,60,70]
pop_front() → 30 leaves the left end. FRONT retracts to index 2
pop_rear() → 70 leaves the right end. REAR retracts to index 4
push_front(25) → front grows all the way left to index 0
pop_rear() → 60 removed. REAR retracts to index 3
pop_rear() → 50 removed. REAR retracts to index 2
Only [40] and [25] remain. Front at [0], Rear at [2]. Both ends still independently accessible.
